Two design questions RESOLVED at the /sorted completeness gate, not deferred. (1) Automatic contradiction detection is KILLED, recorded in out_of_bounds: cosine finds nodes that are ALIKE and a statement and its negation are alike, so proximity can never separate agrees from contradicts, and the only judge would be the host, which librarian charter falsifier (8) bars from the answer path. So REFUTATION IS AN INPUT, NEVER A DISCOVERY — the same shape as the borrowed prior art (cairn ruling supersede is Akien's act and detects nothing either). (2) The asymmetric write, left open at /intent: refutation writes standing='refuted' through the SAME owner-gated update face promotion uses and APPENDS refuter+evidence into provenance.

Mechanism borrowed whole from cairn/machines/ruling's supersession door (2026-08-02), cited not grafted.
